race.comment: SOUL LADY (11) knuckled down late to just arrive in time when second-up recently over this distance at Queanbeyan. Loves this trip and should hold the form at this stage of the prep. Nice each-way chance at big odds. WHOA NELLIE (3) is back after a five-month spell. Scored comfortably first-up last prep at Illawarra Grange then went on to perform well through the entire campaign. Trialling in fine style and should be right in the finish. J Mac is a key booking. MISS EMMA (9) is racing well and has had a stable switch since leading for home before finishing fourth over this distance at Kembla last start. Won two on the trot prior to that at the provincials. Looks well over the odds in early betting. ROSIE ROUGE (12) jumped straight to the lead and defied all challengers when resuming over this distance at Kembla recently. Has only been to the races twice so there is plenty of upside. EVENTS (2) resumes. In the money at all four runs to date so must be highly regarded.
